## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Testing

- [ ] `mvn -B -ntp verify` passes
- [ ] Relevant Jenkins Pipeline examples/tests were updated
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private keys, or other secrets are committed

## Compatibility

- [ ] Public Pipeline DSL remains compatible, or the intentional breaking change is documented
- [ ] Changes to shared contracts were coordinated with `iac-pipeline-api`
- [ ] Documentation reflects any user-visible behavior change
